definitions.short: a row , i.e. rank (of soldiers), story (of rooms)
definitions.full: H7713. sederah [ שְׂדֵרָה ] noun feminine 1. row, rank of soldiers in line . 2 architectural term. (probably for סְדֵרָה , see above and compare Ba § 92 a ); — only plural absolute שְׂדֵרוֺת 2Kin 11:8 ; 2Chr 23:14 , רֹת - 1Kin 6:9 ; 2Kin 11:15 ; — 1 rows, ranks , 2Kin 11:8 , and 11:15 2Chr 23:14 (where thought to be gloss by Benz, on account of מִבַּיִת , within ). 2 technical term of building , בָּאֲרָוִים וּשְׂדֵרֹת גֵּבִים 1Kin 6:9 , meaning unknown.
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to regulate;
